transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I've been feeling incredibly depressed and sad, and I feel completely drained of all my energy. This has been going on for over a year now, about thirteen months, and I just can't seem to shake it. I really need some help.
During these 13 months, have you felt depressed nearly every day the whole time, or were there shorter episodes with periods of feeling back to normal in between?

It has been continuous, and I have felt this heavy sadness and depression nearly every single day without any break. There haven't been any periods where I felt back to normal or like my old self at all. It just feels like a constant, heavy cloud that never lifts.
During this time, have you also had other symptoms like changes in sleep or appetite, trouble concentrating, feeling worthless or guilty, or thoughts of death or suicide?
I haven't really noticed those specific symptoms. Mostly, I just feel this heavy, constant sadness and a complete lack of energy every day.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy during this time?

I haven't really noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things, but it's more that I feel completely numb and empty inside. On top of that, I am just dealing with this profound physical and mental fatigue all the time. It feels like even the simplest tasks take more energy than I have.
How much has this been affecting your daily functioning, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?

It has completely disrupted my daily life because I have absolutely no energy. The constant physical and mental fatigue makes even basic self-care and simple tasks feel impossible to manage. It has also made it incredibly hard to keep up with my responsibilities or maintain relationships.
Besides low energy, have you had poor appetite or overeating, insomnia or sleeping too much, low self-esteem, trouble concentrating, or feeling hopeless during these 13 months?

No, I haven't really experienced those specific symptoms like appetite changes, sleep issues, low self-esteem, or hopelessness. It is mostly just the constant, heavy sadness and the overwhelming exhaustion that I deal with.
Before these 13 months started, had you ever had a similar period of depression or low mood in the past?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before. This is the first time I've ever felt this kind of depression or low mood. Before these past 13 months, my mood was generally fine.

At any point during these 13 months, were there at least 2 straight weeks when the depression became clearly worse and you also had several other symptoms, like poor sleep, appetite change, guilt, poor concentration, or suicidal thoughts?

No, I haven't really experienced those specific symptoms like changes in my sleep, appetite, feelings of guilt, or suicidal thoughts. My general feelings of sadness and extreme fatigue have just been constantly present throughout the entire 13 months without any sudden worsening like that.
Did these symptoms start after a specific stressful life event or major change, like a breakup, loss, move, job problem, or illness?
I can't recall any specific stressful event, major change, or illness that might have triggered this. It just seemed to start on its own about a year and a month ago, and it hasn't let up since.
Just to clarify, has there been any stretch during these 13 months, even up to 2 months, when you were not feeling depressed most days?

No, there hasn't been any break like that at all. I have felt depressed and completely empty every single day for the entire thirteen months. It has just been one long, continuous weight without any relief.
